notes.title: Release Update: New Target Date – September 30
notes.notes: [p][i]The Tale of Relm[/i] is currently in review with Steam. While that’s a big step forward, it means the game won’t release today.[/p][p]Once the review is complete, I’ll still need to run final tests on the Steam build. Because Steam only allows you to change your release date once, I’ve chosen [b]September 30[/b] as the new target date to be sure everything is ready and working properly.[/p][p]Thanks for bearing with me — we’re almost there![/p]
